# Contract — No Fake Reports

**Guarantee**: no report/analytics is generated, computed, charted, or downloaded.
- Report data = authored roll-ups/rows only; no BI engine; no runtime aggregation beyond counting authored rows.
- Export/print/generate = honest gates.
**Verify (smoke)**: no chart/canvas; no computed metric; no generated file; report bodies display-only.
**Fail if**: a report is generated/downloaded/charted/computed.
